d: Lok aastha ke mahaparv chhath puja ki chhata rajdhani patna ke ganga ghaton ke sath-sath shahar ke pramukh parkon men bhi dekhne ko mil rahi hai. isi kram men patna ke punaeechak sthit harbal park men bari sankhya men chhathavratiyon aur shraddhaluon ne astachalgami yani dubte hue bhagvan bhaskar ko sandhya arghy arpit kiya.
